scantlings.assumed: every section; deck, tank-top, bulkhead, wall and divider plate; levels below deck 4; generator, shaft, tank and outfit weights; window fraction; the weld elongation. Shell 14/12/7 mm and bulkhead places are Boats' (damage.js), also assumed. Her real scantlings are not public.
scantlings.notes: a lattice line lumps the members it stands for: 2.8 m sections carry a web and three ordinary frames; a shell node line carries the 0.7 m longitudinals of its girth; hinges scale the same way. k = E A / L, real; solver.dt and friends are read by softbody.js
